seo.title: Lifemem — notes that connect your life
seo.description: Save notes, photos, places, and people. Lifemem builds a living graph of your life — find any moment, see connections, and understand what you've lived.
seo.ogDescription: Your life, as notes — with a graph that grows as you save.
seo.loginDescription: Sign in to Lifemem to continue your notes, graph, and places.
seo.registerDescription: Create a Lifemem account to save notes and watch your life graph grow.
seo.welcomeTitle: Lifemem. Notes that connect your life
seo.welcomeDescription: Save notes, photos, places, and people. Lifemem builds a living graph of your life so you can find any moment later.

hero.title: Your life, as notes.
hero.sub: Speak, shoot, or type. Lifemem links people, places, and notes into a graph you can search.

capture.title: Capture in the moment.
capture.body: Voice, a photo, a pin on the map, or a line of text. One tap is enough.
capture.voiceHint: Thirty seconds on a walk. Kept as audio, read as text.

graph.title: A living graph of what you saved.

search.title: Ask the way you remember.
search.body: Search finds the moment even if the words were never exact.

places.title: Places stay on the map.
places.body: Geo tags and names of streets, parks, kitchens. Open a year and see where you were.
places.caption: The park after rain, a Saturday in August.

privacy.title: Your thoughts stay yours.
privacy.body: Notes live in your account. Export or delete them whenever you want.
privacy.indexTitle: AI indexes. It does not coach.
privacy.indexBody: Models help transcribe and find. They do not diagnose or advise.
privacy.leaveBody: Export everything. Nothing has to stay behind.
